_about: Invalid-data cases for `node tools/validate.js --self-test`. Each case takes the live data (fighters: tools/fixtures/virtual/data/fighters), applies the mutation, and must produce the expected finding, which the unmutated data must not already produce. `set` maps a JSON pointer to a new value; `del` lists pointers to remove. `expect.rule` is a schema keyword or an `xref:` rule; `expect.pointer` is optional; `expect.file` defaults to the first mutated file. At least three cases per schema are required. A case whose pointer no longer exists fails with 'fixture path missing': update the case when the data's shape changes.
